notes.title: Quality of life and bugfixes update
notes.notes:
First of all, I want to thank you for your help and support. The release went better than I expected, and I'm very grateful.

I'm working on improving the game. Here are some of the changes you can expect in the near future:
[olist]
[*] Quality of life improvements and bug fixes based on your feedback. This update just went live (more details below)
[*] Balance changes, which may take a bit longer to get to Steam (in 1-2 weeks).
[*] A small content update, with some new relics (in 1 month).
[/olist]

Here are the changes:
[b]Quality of life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hovering over a unit now shows its mythology
[*] Casual mode difficulty is now unlocked from the start
[*] You can now freeze gods with a right click while targeting (helpful with Spirit of Desire)
[*] Made the triple effect for gods of all mythologies (including the Unity blessing) more visible
[*] Added a light highlight when you find a second copy of a god in the Pantheon
[*] Star chart can no longer appear as the first relic option (instantly prompting you to select the mythologies even if you don't want it)
[*] Mortal uprising can no longer appear after you pick Divine purge (not that it was a good idea picking it)
[*] The mythology substituted by mythology-specific relics is now random
[*] Added 1.5x (by popular demand)
[*] Added the relic crowns that show which relics have led you to victory to the Pantheon mode
[*] Improved the attack animations
[*] Removed Earth defender from the pool of cards you can randomly get from Living Whirlwind
[*] Casual level is now remembered for each enemy
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Anu and Tezcatlipoca now work with blessings and relics
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Sacrificial Shade to not work sometimes
[*] Cthulhu's counter now resets after trigger (also added an animation for the effect)
[*] Fixed a bug that made the "Relic master" achievement not unlock. You will have to win a run to unlock it.
[*] Fixed the order of attacking with the blessing Primordial echo
[*] Twin elevation now triggers for all pairs when you pick it up
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the 3rd shield to not show up (if you have Aegis shield and Sacred barrier)
[*] Fixed the display of related gods while discovering (for example, Khnum)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Echo elemental to trigger on gods that you'd dismissed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Exalted elevation to remove acquired abilities (like ethereal shield or fury)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused enemies to attack between your attacks when you had fury and first strike
[*] Fixed the interaction between Celestial chains and Divine alignment
[*] Fixed a bug that caused defeats to count as victories for the achievement (this won't take away your crowns)
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉 Gods vs Horrors Launches May 5th, 2025! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that Gods vs Horrors will officially release on May 5th, 2025!

Thank you so much to everyone who has played the demo, shared feedback, and supported the development over the past months. Your help has been huge in shaping the game into what it is today.
Gods vs Horrors is a single-player roguelike card autobattler focused on drafting, scaling, and positioning.
You’ll recruit powerful Gods from 10 mythologies, create crazy synergies, and build unstoppable teams to take down terrifying cosmic horrors - all through strategic choices, not random luck.

🔥 Here's a quick reminder of what you can expect:
[list]
[*] Draft and build your army from 170 Gods, 90 blessings, and 30 relics.
[*] Adapt your strategy to enemy compositions and shifting pantheon options.
[*] Fight deterministic, easy-to-follow battles—no RNG, no surprises—just pure skill.
[*] Unlock new content as you play, expanding your choices without power creep.
[*] Challenge powerful bosses and survive chaotic battlefields in Unknown Calamity mode.
[*] Tweak the challenge with difficulty modifiers to really test your builds.
[/list]

If you haven't already, don't forget to wishlist the game and try the demo if you want a head start before May 5th! 🚀

Thanks again for all your support - can't wait to see the crazy builds you come up with at full release!

Oriol

notes.title: Announcing Gods vs Horrors - a roguelike card auto-battler!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We’re incredibly excited to reveal Gods vs Horrors, a roguelike card auto-battler focusing on synergies, scaling, and positioning.
Check out the trailer:

[h2]How is it played?[/h2]
Gods vs Horrors captures the pure essence of drafting in card games, focusing on synergies, scaling, and positioning. If you love making decks more than actually playing them, this is your game.

The gameplay alternates between drafting and automated combat phases:
In the drafting phase, you’ll recruit and dismiss Gods, level up the pantheon to access stronger Gods, and roll your options. By drafting you’ll build strong synergies and scaling mechanisms, making your build exponentially more powerful than its individual components.
Before combat, you’ll have the opportunity to position your Gods for optimal damage. Combat is automatic, easy-to-follow, and has no RNG; allowing you to understand what is going on and diagnose why you won or lost the last fight.
gameplay gif

[h2]Who is making it?[/h2]
Gods vs Horrors is made by Oriol Cosp (developer and game designer) with the support of Isaac Murgadella (Illustrator), and Enric Cosp (Musician). They already released The Ouroboros King in 2023 on Steam with 18k units sold during the first year and 87% of positive reviews.

[h2]What languages will Gods vs Horrors be playable in?[/h2]
English, German, French, Polish, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian and Catalan

[h2]When can I play it?[/h2]
We expect to release a demo during the summer, and the full game in early 2025.

That’s all for now!
If you’d like to keep up to date with more Gods vs Horrors info wishlist the game and join the [url=https://discord.gg/VeDmFJZrR9]Discord [/url] to chat with the developers.
If you want to show some extra support, you can retweet the [url=https://x.com/OriolCosp_Game/status/1798291113641680977]announcement[/url].

Cheers!
